message.content:
Let's use `run_command` with python to run the calculation script.
```python
script = '''python -c "
distance_moon = 356400.0  # km (minimum perigee on Moon Wikipedia page)
marathon_dist = 42.195  # km

# Kipchoge world record (official): 2:01:09
t1 = 2 + 1/60 + 9/3600
speed1 = marathon_dist / t1
time_hours1 = distance_moon / speed1
k_hours1 = time_hours1 / 1000

# Kipchoge INEOS 1:59 challenge (unofficial record / sub-2 hour): 1:59:40
t2 = 1 + 59/60 + 40/3600
speed2 = marathon_dist / t2
time_hours2 = distance_moon / speed2
k_hours2 = time_hours2 / 1000

print(f'Official WR 2:01:09 -> speed: {speed1:.4f} km/h, hours: {time_hours1:.2f}, k_hours: {k_hours1:.4f}, rounded: {round(k_hours1)}')
print(f'INEOS 1:59:40 -> speed: {speed2:.4f} km/h, hours: {time_hours2:.2f}, k_hours: {k_hours2:.4f}, rounded: {round(k_hours2)}')
"'''
out = await run_command(script)
print(out)
```
